function copyBase(){return JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(BASE));}
function safeLoad(){try{const v=JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(KEY)||'null');return v&&typeof v==='object'&&v.templates&&v.completions?v:null}catch{return null}}
const saved=safeLoad();let data=saved||{templates:copyBase(),completions:{},stepChecks:{},overrides:{}};
for(const k of ['completions','stepChecks','overrides']) if(!data[k])data[k]={};
if(!Array.isArray(data.weekPlans)||data.weekPlans.length!==4)data.weekPlans=JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(WEEK_PLANS));

let editingWeek=0;let view='calendar',month=new Date(new Date().getFullYear(),new Date().getMonth(),1),selected=localISO(new Date()),activeExercise=0,editingDay=1,editingId=null,celebrating=false;
let timer={running:false,remaining:0,initial:0,interval:null,endAt:0,source:null};
function persist(){try{localStorage.setItem(KEY,JSON.stringify(data));return true}catch{return false}}
function localISO(date){return `${date.getFullYear()}-${String(date.getMonth()+1).padStart(2,'0')}-${String(date.getDate()).padStart(2,'0')}`}
function dateFrom(iso){const [y,m,d]=iso.split('-').map(Number);return new Date(y,m-1,d)}
function pretty(iso,opt={weekday:'long',month:'long',day:'numeric'}){return dateFrom(iso).toLocaleDateString('en-US',opt)}
function weekIndex(iso){const d=dateFrom(iso),first=new Date(d.getFullYear(),d.getMonth(),1);const dow=first.getDay();const firstMonday=1+((8-(dow||7))%7);return d.getDate()<firstMonday?0:Math.floor((d.getDate()-firstMonday)/7)%4}
function getWorkout(iso){const d=dateFrom(iso),w=d.getDay(),wi=weekIndex(iso);const t=JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(data.weekPlans?.[wi]?.[w]||WEEK_PLANS[wi][w]));const o=data.overrides[iso];return o?{...t,...o,exercises:o.exercises||t.exercises}:t}
function escapeText(s){return String(s??'').replace(/[&<>"']/g,c=>({'&':'&amp;','<':'&lt;','>':'&gt;','"':'&quot;',"'":'&#39;'}[c]))}
function nav(v){stopTimer();view=v;render();window.scrollTo(0,0)}
function openDay(iso){selected=iso;activeExercise=0;nav('day')}
function startExercise(i){activeExercise=i;const w=getWorkout(selected);const e=w.exercises[i];if(!e)return;stopTimer();timer.initial=Math.max(0,+e.seconds||0);timer.remaining=timer.initial;nav('exercise')}
function notify(s){const e=document.querySelector('#toast');e.textContent=s;e.classList.add('show');clearTimeout(notify.timeout);notify.timeout=setTimeout(()=>e.classList.remove('show'),2600)}
function monthStats(){let total=0,complete=0,rest=0;const y=month.getFullYear(),m=month.getMonth(),end=new Date(y,m+1,0).getDate();for(let d=1;d<=end;d++){const iso=localISO(new Date(y,m,d));if(getWorkout(iso).rest){rest++;continue}total++;if(data.completions[iso])complete++}return {total,complete,rest,remaining:total-complete,pct:total?Math.round(100*complete/total):0}}
function side(){const menu=[['calendar','CALENDAR'],['progress','PROGRESS'],['settings','PARENT TOOLS']];return `<aside class="side"><div class="brand"><img src="${LOGO}" alt="Prodigy Pioneers baseball logo"><div><h1>PRODIGY<br>PIONEERS</h1><small>WORKOUT CLUB</small></div></div><div class="sidebar-title">YOUR DUGOUT</div><div class="nav">${menu.map(([v,l])=>`<button type="button" class="${(view===v||(view==='day'&&v==='calendar')||(view==='exercise'&&v==='calendar'))?'active':''}" data-nav="${v}">${ICONS[v]}<span>${l}</span></button>`).join('')}</div><div class="sideline"><b>⚾ Attitude + Effort</b><p>Have fun, practice good form and give your best effort. Parent supervision recommended.</p></div></aside>`}
function bottom(){return `<nav class="bottomnav" aria-label="Main navigation">${[['calendar','▦','CALENDAR'],['progress','◉','PROGRESS'],['settings','⚙','PARENT']].map(([v,i,l])=>`<button type="button" data-nav="${v}" class="${view===v||((view==='day'||view==='exercise')&&v==='calendar')?'active':''}"><span class="nav-ico">${i}</span>${l}</button>`).join('')}</nav>`}
function calendarView(){const y=month.getFullYear(),m=month.getMonth(),first=new Date(y,m,1).getDay(),num=new Date(y,m+1,0).getDate(),today=localISO(new Date()),stats=monthStats(),dNow=getWorkout(today);let cells='';for(let i=0;i<42;i++){let day=i-first+1;if(day<1||day>num){cells+=`<div class="date-cell outside" aria-hidden="true"></div>`;continue}const iso=localISO(new Date(y,m,day)),w=getWorkout(iso),isDone=!!data.completions[iso];cells+=`<button class="date-cell ${w.rest?'rest':''} ${isDone?'complete':''} ${iso===today?'today':''} ${iso===selected?'selected':''}" type="button" data-day="${iso}" aria-label="${pretty(iso)}, ${w.title}${isDone?', completed':''}"><span class="date-num">${day}${isDone?'<span class="sr">completed</span>':''}</span><span class="day-mini">${isDone?'✓ ':''}${escapeText(w.short)}</span></button>`}const isCurrent=month.getFullYear()===new Date().getFullYear()&&month.getMonth()===new Date().getMonth();return `<div class="topbar"><div><div class="eyebrow">READY TO PLAY BALL?</div><h2>Your workout calendar</h2><p class="sub">Pick a day. Follow the drills. Finish strong.</p></div><span class="pill teal">⚾ PRODIGY PIONEERS</span></div><div class="two-col"><section class="panel"><div class="month-top"><div><div class="month-label">${month.toLocaleDateString('en-US',{month:'long',year:'numeric'})}</div><div class="sub" style="font-size:12px">${stats.complete} of ${stats.total} workouts completed</div></div><div class="month-arrows"><button class="icon-btn" data-action="prevMonth" aria-label="Previous month">‹</button><button class="icon-btn" data-action="goToday" aria-label="Go to current month">⌂</button><button class="icon-btn" data-action="nextMonth" aria-label="Next month">›</button></div></div><div class="calendar-grid">${['SUN','MON','TUE','WED','THU','FRI','SAT'].map(x=>`<div class="day-name">${x}</div>`).join('')}${cells}</div></section><div><div class="now-card"><div class="eyebrow">${isCurrent?'TODAY’S LINEUP':'FEATURED DAY'}</div><h3>${escapeText(isCurrent?dNow.title:getWorkout(localISO(new Date(y,m,1))).title)}</h3><p>${escapeText(isCurrent?dNow.goal:'Tap a date in the calendar to see its full training plan.')}</p><span class="pill">${isCurrent?pretty(today,{weekday:'long',month:'short',day:'numeric'}):month.toLocaleDateString('en-US',{month:'long',year:'numeric'})}</span><div><button class="btn btn-primary" data-day="${isCurrent?today:localISO(new Date(y,m,1))}">${isCurrent?'OPEN TODAY’S WORKOUT':'VIEW FIRST DAY'} →</button></div></div><div style="margin-top:23px"><div class="sectionline"><h3>This week’s lineup</h3><span class="pill teal">WEEK ${weekIndex(isCurrent?today:localISO(new Date(y,m,1)))+1} OF 4</span></div><div class="quicklist">${[1,2,3,4,5,6,0].map(d=>{const w=data.weekPlans[weekIndex(isCurrent?today:localISO(new Date(y,m,1)))][d];return `<div class="quickline"><span class="circleicon">${LINEUP_ICONS[d]}</span><div><b>${DAY_NAMES[d]}</b><small>${escapeText(w.title)}</small></div>${w.rest?'<span class="pill">REST</span>':''}</div>`}).join('')}</div></div></div></div><p class="footer-hint">✓ Completed • REST = recovery day. Your progress is saved in this browser on this device.</p>`}
function dayView(){const w=getWorkout(selected),done=!!data.completions[selected], checks=data.stepChecks[selected]||{};return `<button class="page-back" data-nav="calendar">← Back to calendar</button><div class="workout-banner"><div><div class="eyebrow" style="color:#9becde">${pretty(selected).toUpperCase()} · WEEK ${weekIndex(selected)+1} OF 4</div><h2>${escapeText(w.title)}</h2><p>${escapeText(w.goal)}</p><div style="margin-top:13px;display:flex;gap:7px;flex-wrap:wrap"><span class="pill">${w.rest?'REST DAY':`${w.minutes} MINUTES`}</span>${done?'<span class="pill teal">✓ COMPLETE</span>':''}</div></div><img class="logo-med" src="${LOGO}" alt="Prodigy Pioneers logo"></div>${w.rest?`<div class="rest-card"><div class="bigicon">⚾</div><h3>Recovery is part of the game!</h3><p>Rest, enjoy your day and come back ready to play. There’s nothing to check off today.</p><button class="btn btn-primary" data-nav="calendar">Back to calendar →</button></div>`:`<div class="sectionline"><div><h3>Today's lineup</h3><p class="sub">${w.exercises.length} preloaded activities • Warm-up, skill work, water breaks & cool-down</p></div></div><div class="steps">${w.exercises.map((e,i)=>`<div class="step ${checks[e.id]?'done':''}"><div class="step-head"><div class="step-number">${checks[e.id]?'✓':String(i+1).padStart(2,'0')}</div><div class="step-body"><b>${escapeText(e.name)}</b><small>${e.sets} set${+e.sets===1?'':'s'} · ${escapeText(e.reps)}${e.blockMinutes?' · ~'+e.blockMinutes+' min':''}${e.seconds?' · timer':''}</small></div><div class="step-actions"><button class="tiny-button" aria-label="${checks[e.id]?'Uncheck':'Check off'} ${escapeText(e.name)}" data-check="${i}">${checks[e.id]?'✓':'○'}</button><button class="tiny-button" aria-label="Open ${escapeText(e.name)}" data-exercise="${i}">›</button></div></div><div class="step-detail"><p>${escapeText(e.how)}</p><button class="btn btn-outline btn-small" data-exercise="${i}">OPEN DRILL ${e.seconds?'& TIMER':'& VIDEO'} →</button></div></div>`).join('')}</div><div class="completion-strip"><div><b>${done?'Home run! You did it.':'Done with today’s workout?'}</b><small>${done?'This date is saved as complete.':'Finish when you’ve had fun and given your best.'}</small></div><button class="btn ${done?'btn-outline':'btn-primary'}" data-action="finish">${done?'↻ CELEBRATE AGAIN':'⚾ FINISH WORKOUT'}</button></div><p class="footer-hint">Parent note: 30–45 minutes includes coaching, water breaks, and relaxed practice — not nonstop exertion. Stop if something hurts. Team practice or a game may replace this session.</p>`}`}
function exerciseView(){const w=getWorkout(selected),e=w.exercises[activeExercise];if(!e){nav('day');return ''}const checks=data.stepChecks[selected]||{},done=!!checks[e.id];return `<button class="page-back" data-nav="day">← Back to ${escapeText(w.title)}</button><div class="eyebrow">DRILL ${activeExercise+1} OF ${w.exercises.length}</div><h2>${escapeText(e.name)}</h2><p class="sub">${e.sets} set${+e.sets===1?'':'s'} · ${escapeText(e.reps)} · ${escapeText(e.equipment||'No equipment')}${e.blockMinutes?' · ~'+e.blockMinutes+' min':''}</p><div style="margin-top:20px">${e.seconds?`<div class="timer-panel"><small>EXERCISE TIMER</small><div class="timer-value" id="time-value" aria-live="off">${formatSeconds(timer.remaining)}</div><div class="timer-controls"><button class="btn btn-primary" data-action="toggleTimer" id="timer-toggle">${timer.running?'Ⅱ PAUSE':'▶ START'}</button><button class="btn btn-outline" data-action="resetTimer">↻ RESET</button></div></div>`:`<div class="timer-panel"><small>REPS & SETS</small><div class="timer-value" style="font-size:clamp(42px,9vw,68px)">${escapeText(e.reps)}</div><p style="color:#acd8ce;margin-bottom:13px">Complete ${e.sets} set${+e.sets===1?'':'s'} with good form and breaks as needed.</p><button class="btn btn-primary" data-check="${activeExercise}">${done?'✓ MARKED DONE':'✓ MARK DRILL DONE'}</button></div>`}</div><div class="explain"><h3>How to do it</h3><p>${escapeText(e.how)}</p><p style="margin-top:9px;font-size:12px"><b>Equipment:</b> ${escapeText(e.equipment||'None')}</p></div><div class="video-box"><div><strong>▶ Watch the demonstration</strong><span>${String(e.url).includes('results?')?'Opens a targeted demonstration search':String(e.url).includes('/play-ball/mojo')?'Opens the MLB Play Ball drill library':'Opens a linked demonstration video'}</span></div><button class="btn btn-primary btn-small" data-action="watchVideo">WATCH ↗</button></div><div class="completion-strip" style="margin-top:16px"><div><b>${done?'Drill complete!':'Ready for the next drill?'}</b><small>You can always come back to review it.</small></div><div style="display:flex;gap:8px"><button class="btn btn-outline btn-small" data-check="${activeExercise}">${done?'UNDO CHECK':'✓ CHECK OFF'}</button><button class="btn btn-dark btn-small" data-action="nextDrill">${activeExercise===w.exercises.length-1?'BACK TO DAY':'NEXT →'}</button></div></div>`}
function progressView(){const st=monthStats();return `<div class="topbar"><div><div class="eyebrow">YOUR SEASON STATS</div><h2>Training progress</h2><p class="sub">Every good effort counts, at your own pace.</p></div></div><div class="panel panel-pad"><div class="sectionline"><h3>${month.toLocaleDateString('en-US',{month:'long',year:'numeric'})}</h3><div style="display:flex;gap:5px"><button class="icon-btn" data-action="prevMonth">‹</button><button class="icon-btn" data-action="nextMonth">›</button></div></div><div class="progress-hero"><div><span>Workouts in the books</span><strong>${st.complete}<span style="font-size:25px">/${st.total}</span></strong><span>${st.pct}% of scheduled workouts complete</span></div><div class="progress-ring" style="--pct:${st.pct}%"><b>${st.pct}%</b></div></div><div class="mini-stat-row"><div class="mini-stat"><strong>${st.complete}</strong><span>Completed</span></div><div class="mini-stat"><strong>${st.remaining}</strong><span>Not yet done</span></div><div class="mini-stat"><strong>${st.rest}</strong><span>Rest days</span></div></div><div class="banner-note">⚾ Missing a day doesn't mean you've failed. Fun, good form and consistency over time matter more than a perfect calendar.</div><button class="btn btn-primary" data-nav="calendar">← GO TO CALENDAR</button></div>`}
function settingsView(){let week=[1,2,3,4,5,6,0],w=data.weekPlans[editingWeek][editingDay];return `<div class="topbar"><div><div class="eyebrow">FOR PARENTS</div><h2>Adjust the game plan</h2><p class="sub">All workouts are ready to use. Edit only what you want to change.</p></div></div><div class="banner-note"><b>These edits update this day in the selected week of the 4-week monthly cycle</b> in this browser. Progress already recorded on specific dates stays saved. This prototype stores information on this device only, without accounts or a parent PIN.</div><section class="panel panel-pad"><div class="sectionline"><h3>Choose week and workout day</h3><span class="pill teal">PARENT TOOLS</span></div><div style="display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:7px;margin-bottom:12px">${[0,1,2,3].map(wi=>`<button class="btn btn-small ${editingWeek===wi?'btn-primary':'btn-outline'}" data-editweek="${wi}">WEEK ${wi+1}</button>`).join('')}</div><div style="display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:7px;margin-bottom:21px">${week.map(d=>`<button class="btn btn-small ${editingDay===d?'btn-primary':'btn-outline'}" data-editday="${d}">${DAY_NAMES[d].slice(0,3).toUpperCase()}</button>`).join('')}</div><div class="field full"><label for="workoutTitle">Workout title</label><input id="workoutTitle" value="${escapeText(w.title)}" maxlength="80"></div><div class="form-grid" style="margin-top:12px"><label class="field full">Daily goal<textarea id="workoutGoal">${escapeText(w.goal)}</textarea></label><label class="field">Minutes estimate<input type="number" min="0" max="120" id="workoutMinutes" value="${w.minutes}"></label><label class="field">Calendar label<input id="workoutShort" maxlength="13" value="${escapeText(w.short)}"></label></div><div style="margin-top:12px;display:flex;gap:10px;flex-wrap:wrap"><button class="btn btn-primary" data-action="saveWorkout">SAVE WORKOUT INFO</button><button class="btn btn-outline" data-action="resetDay">RESTORE DEFAULTS</button></div><hr style="margin:23px 0;border:0;border-top:1px solid var(--line)"><div class="sectionline"><div><h3>Preloaded drills</h3><p class="sub">Adjust names, reps, time, and links without rebuilding the app.</p></div>${!w.rest?'<button class="btn btn-small btn-outline" data-action="addDrill">+ ADD</button>':''}</div>${w.rest?'<p class="empty">This is a rest day. No workout is scheduled.</p>':w.exercises.map((e,i)=>`<div class="edititem"><div class="edithead"><b>${i+1}. ${escapeText(e.name)}</b><div style="display:flex;gap:5px"><button class="tiny-button" data-move="${i}:up" title="Move up" aria-label="Move ${escapeText(e.name)} up">↑</button><button class="tiny-button" data-move="${i}:down" title="Move down" aria-label="Move ${escapeText(e.name)} down">↓</button><button class="tiny-button" data-remove="${i}" title="Remove drill" aria-label="Remove ${escapeText(e.name)}">×</button></div></div><div class="form-grid"><label class="field full">Exercise name<input data-edit="${i}:name" value="${escapeText(e.name)}"></label><label class="field">Sets<input data-edit="${i}:sets" type="number" min="1" max="20" value="${e.sets}"></label><label class="field">Reps or time label<input data-edit="${i}:reps" value="${escapeText(e.reps)}"></label><label class="field">Timer seconds (0 for reps)<input data-edit="${i}:seconds" type="number" min="0" max="3600" value="${e.seconds||0}"></label><label class="field">Time budget (minutes)<input data-edit="${i}:blockMinutes" type="number" min="1" max="45" value="${e.blockMinutes||5}"></label><label class="field">Equipment<input data-edit="${i}:equipment" value="${escapeText(e.equipment||'')}"></label><label class="field full">Instructions<textarea data-edit="${i}:how">${escapeText(e.how)}</textarea></label><label class="field full">Demonstration video or search URL<input data-edit="${i}:url" value="${escapeText(e.url)}"></label></div></div>`).join('')}<div style="display:flex;gap:10px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-top:16px">${!w.rest?'<button class="btn btn-primary" data-action="saveDrills">SAVE ALL DRILLS</button>':''}<button class="btn btn-outline" data-nav="calendar">RETURN TO CALENDAR</button></div></section><section class="panel panel-pad" style="margin-top:16px"><div class="sectionline"><h3>Backup & restore</h3></div><p class="sub">Progress stays in this browser, not automatically across devices. Save a backup file before clearing browser data or changing phones.</p><div style="display:flex;gap:10px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-top:14px"><button class="btn btn-outline btn-small" data-action="export">↓ EXPORT BACKUP</button><label class="btn btn-outline btn-small" style="cursor:pointer">↑ IMPORT BACKUP<input id="importFile" type="file" accept="application/json,.json" hidden></label></div></section>`}
function celebrateView(){if(!celebrating)return '';let chips='';for(let i=0;i<70;i++){const size=3+i%4*2;chips+=`<span class="confetti" style="--left:${(i*47)%100}%;--size:${size}px;--duration:${2.5+(i%8)*.31}s;--delay:${-(i%16)*.34}s;--sway:${(i%2?1:-1)*(40+i%50)}px;--rot:${i*33}deg;--color:${i%3===0?'#00A898':i%3===1?'#FFFFFF':'#0D1514'}"></span>`}return `<div class="celebrate" role="dialog" aria-label="Workout completed" aria-modal="true">${chips}<div class="celebrate-inner"><img src="${LOGO}" alt="Prodigy team logo"><div class="eyebrow">GREAT ATTITUDE. GREAT EFFORT.</div><h2>HOME RUN!</h2><p>Workout complete! You showed up and gave it your best. That's a win worth celebrating.</p><button class="btn btn-primary" data-action="closeCelebrate">BACK TO CALENDAR →</button></div></div>`}
function render(){const body=view==='calendar'?calendarView():view==='day'?dayView():view==='exercise'?exerciseView():view==='progress'?progressView():settingsView();document.querySelector('#app').innerHTML=`<div class="shell">${side()}<main class="main">${body}</main>${bottom()}</div>${celebrateView()}`;refreshTimerDom()}
function formatSeconds(s){return `${String(Math.floor(s/60)).padStart(2,'0')}:${String(s%60).padStart(2,'0')}`}
function refreshTimerDom(){const el=document.querySelector('#time-value');if(el)el.textContent=formatSeconds(Math.max(0,timer.remaining));const btn=document.querySelector('#timer-toggle');if(btn)btn.textContent=timer.running?'Ⅱ PAUSE':timer.remaining===0?'↻ RESTART':'▶ START'}
function stopTimer(){if(timer.interval)clearInterval(timer.interval);timer.interval=null;timer.running=false}
function startPauseTimer(){if(timer.running){timer.remaining=Math.max(0,Math.ceil((timer.endAt-Date.now())/1000));stopTimer();refreshTimerDom();return}if(timer.remaining<=0)timer.remaining=timer.initial;if(timer.remaining<=0){notify('This drill uses reps, not a timer.');return}timer.running=true;timer.endAt=Date.now()+timer.remaining*1000;timer.interval=setInterval(()=>{timer.remaining=Math.max(0,Math.ceil((timer.endAt-Date.now())/1000));refreshTimerDom();if(timer.remaining<=0){stopTimer();notify('Time! Nice job! ⚾');}},140);refreshTimerDom()}
function checkStep(i){const w=getWorkout(selected),e=w.exercises[i];if(!e)return;if(!data.stepChecks[selected])data.stepChecks[selected]={};data.stepChecks[selected][e.id]=!data.stepChecks[selected][e.id];persist();const previous=view;render();if(previous==='exercise')notify(data.stepChecks[selected][e.id]?'Drill checked off!':'Drill unchecked.')}
function shiftMonth(n){month=new Date(month.getFullYear(),month.getMonth()+n,1);render()}
function saveWorkout(){const w=data.weekPlans[editingWeek][editingDay];w.title=document.getElementById('workoutTitle').value.trim()||w.title;w.goal=document.getElementById('workoutGoal').value.trim()||w.goal;w.minutes=Math.max(0,Math.min(120,Number(document.getElementById('workoutMinutes').value)||0));w.short=document.getElementById('workoutShort').value.trim().slice(0,13)||w.short;data.weekPlans[editingWeek][editingDay]=w;persist();notify('Workout updated.');render()}
function saveDrills(){const w=data.weekPlans[editingWeek][editingDay];document.querySelectorAll('[data-edit]').forEach(el=>{const [i,k]=el.dataset.edit.split(':');if(!w.exercises[+i])return;let v=el.value;if(k==='sets')v=Math.max(1,Math.min(20,parseInt(v,10)||1));if(k==='seconds')v=Math.max(0,Math.min(3600,parseInt(v,10)||0));if(k==='blockMinutes')v=Math.max(1,Math.min(45,parseInt(v,10)||5));if(k==='url'&&!/^https:\/\//.test(v))v='https://www.youtube.com/results?search_query='+encodeURIComponent((w.exercises[+i].name||'baseball drill')+' exercise demonstration');w.exercises[+i][k]=v});data.weekPlans[editingWeek][editingDay]=w;persist();notify('Drills saved.');render()}
function action(act){switch(act){case'prevMonth':shiftMonth(-1);break;case'nextMonth':shiftMonth(1);break;case'goToday':month=new Date(new Date().getFullYear(),new Date().getMonth(),1);selected=localISO(new Date());render();break;case'toggleTimer':startPauseTimer();break;case'resetTimer':stopTimer();timer.remaining=timer.initial;refreshTimerDom();break;case'watchVideo':{const e=getWorkout(selected).exercises[activeExercise];if(e&&/^https:\/\//.test(e.url)){const tab=window.open(e.url,'_blank','noopener,noreferrer');if(!tab)notify('Video popup blocked — allow popups to watch.')}else notify('Video link is unavailable.');break}case'nextDrill':{const len=getWorkout(selected).exercises.length;if(activeExercise+1<len)startExercise(activeExercise+1);else nav('day');break}case'finish':data.completions[selected]=true;persist();stopTimer();celebrating=true;render();break;case'closeCelebrate':celebrating=false;nav('calendar');break;case'saveWorkout':saveWorkout();break;case'saveDrills':saveDrills();break;case'resetDay':if(confirm('Restore the preloaded Week '+(editingWeek+1)+' '+DAY_NAMES[editingDay]+' workout?')){data.weekPlans[editingWeek][editingDay]=JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(WEEK_PLANS[editingWeek][editingDay]));persist();render();notify('Restored original workout.')}break;case'addDrill':{const w=data.weekPlans[editingWeek][editingDay];if(!w||w.rest)return;w.exercises.push({id:'custom'+Date.now(),name:'New drill',sets:1,reps:'8 reps',seconds:0,blockMinutes:5,how:'Practice with good form and adult supervision.',equipment:'None',url:'https://www.youtube.com/results?search_query=baseball+kids+exercise+drill'});persist();render();notify('Drill added — edit the details below.');break}case'export':{const json=JSON.stringify({format:'prodigy-workout-2',savedAt:new Date().toISOString(),data},null,2),blob=new Blob([json],{type:'application/json'}),u=URL.createObjectURL(blob),a=document.createElement('a');a.href=u;a.download='prodigy-workout-backup.json';a.click();setTimeout(()=>URL.revokeObjectURL(u),2000);break}}}
document.addEventListener('click',e=>{const t=e.target.closest('[data-nav],[data-day],[data-exercise],[data-action],[data-check],[data-editday],[data-editweek],[data-remove],[data-move]');if(!t)return;if(t.hasAttribute('data-nav'))nav(t.dataset.nav);else if(t.hasAttribute('data-day'))openDay(t.dataset.day);else if(t.hasAttribute('data-exercise'))startExercise(+t.dataset.exercise);else if(t.hasAttribute('data-action'))action(t.dataset.action);else if(t.hasAttribute('data-check'))checkStep(+t.dataset.check);else if(t.hasAttribute('data-editday')){editingDay=+t.dataset.editday;render()}else if(t.hasAttribute('data-editweek')){editingWeek=+t.dataset.editweek;render()}else if(t.hasAttribute('data-remove')){const i=+t.dataset.remove,w=data.templates[editingDay];if(w.exercises.length<=1){notify('Keep at least one drill.');return}if(confirm('Remove this drill from '+DAY_NAMES[editingDay]+'?')){w.exercises.splice(i,1);persist();render()}}else if(t.hasAttribute('data-move')){const [s,d]=t.dataset.move.split(':'),i=+s,w=data.templates[editingDay],j=i+(d==='up'?-1:1);if(j>=0&&j<w.exercises.length){[w.exercises[i],w.exercises[j]]=[w.exercises[j],w.exercises[i]];persist();render()}}});
document.addEventListener('change',async e=>{if(e.target.id==='importFile'){const f=e.target.files?.[0];if(!f)return;try{const parsed=JSON.parse(await f.text());if(!['prodigy-workout-1','prodigy-workout-2'].includes(parsed.format)||!parsed.data?.templates||!parsed.data?.completions)throw Error('Invalid backup');if(!confirm('Replace the workouts and progress in this browser with the backup?'))return;data=parsed.data;if(!Array.isArray(data.weekPlans)||data.weekPlans.length!==4)data.weekPlans=JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(WEEK_PLANS));persist();month=new Date();month=new Date(month.getFullYear(),month.getMonth(),1);notify('Backup restored.');nav('calendar')}catch{notify('Could not import this backup file.')}}});
document.addEventListener('keydown',e=>{if(e.key==='Escape'&&celebrating){celebrating=false;nav('calendar')}});
render();
</script></body></html>
